title.narrative: Study visit on sustainable development of coffee region Junin

description.narrative: This project is a direct follow-up of a Sustainable and Inclusive Business Scan conducted in September 2016, assigned by the Netherlands embassy in Lima, Peru.Potential opportunities for Dutch private sector involvement were identified during this assignment in water and soil management, valorisation of waste streams, circular economy technology and expertise, sustainable infrastructure development, and spatial development. These themes relate to several sectors and value chains that were assessed: agrifood, urban development, logistics and waste management.The sustainable coffee sector was identified as having a high potential for growth and impact. Several essential stakeholders, such as SNV, Agriterra, Solidaridad, and Coopchebi, were interviewed. There is a plan to create a cross-sectoral approach to improve the coffee value chain and enhance cooperation between Peruvian and Dutch stakeholders. The first step towards this goal is an exploratory business mission to Selva Central, which involves the Dutch coffee sector.The Netherlands embassy in Lima requested MVO Nederland to prepare and organise a mission to the ExpoAlimentaria in Lima and La Selva Central with the objective to: • Bring together the essential national and regional players in the value chain;• Introduce Dutch experts on sustainable regional development and sustainable production;• Identify business opportunities for Peruvian and Dutch companies.• The overall outcome of the mission is that Peruvian and Dutch stakeholders and businesses have expressed serious interest in joint future cooperation. The final report provides insight into the outcome and the opportunities for follow-up. In 2018 MVO Nederland will be organising and hosting networking sessions to inspire companies, keep the network engaged and mobilise new stakeholders to join. Moreover, MVO Nederland will be safeguarding the process for creating a project that unites a variety of business cases that will have a sustainable impact in both the La Selva region in Peru and the Netherlands.
